parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file does what an application use case should do: it coordinates the work and leaves the rules to other layers. It has no persistence code, no transport or framework handling, and no business rules of its own. Converting the due date to an ISO string is just DTO mapping, which belongs in the application layer.
